verified_facts.text: The inn originally opened as the Central Hotel in 1886 and served as a stagecoach stop during the California gold rush years.
verified_facts.excerpt: originally opened as the Central Hotel in 1886 and served as a popular stagecoach stop during the California gold rush years

verified_facts.text: The property was a prohibition-era speakeasy and an automobile touring stopover in its later years.

verified_facts.text: The inn is a Santa Barbara County Historical Landmark.
verified_facts.excerpt: A Santa Barbara County Historical Landmark, The Inn at Mattei's Tavern has been a popular traveler's refuge since the 1880s

verified_facts.text: The property is set on 6.5 acres with old-growth palm trees.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set on 6.5 acres populated with old-growth palm trees and close to the many nearby vineyards

verified_facts.text: Santa Barbara-based architecture firm DMHA and AvroKO's San Francisco office were on the development team.

verified_facts.text: The inn is in the town of Los Olivos in the Santa Ynez Valley, in Santa Barbara County, California.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located in the heart of Los Olivos, The Inn at Mattei’s Tavern will celebrate the relaxed attitude and pioneering spirit of the Santa Ynez Valley.

verified_facts.text: Los Olivos is home to 30 wine-tasting rooms, restaurants, art galleries and boutiques.
